purpose: Physics validation gates — trustworthiness of pipeline numbers.

anchor_spread_required.note: 4 orders of magnitude in binding + full polarity range; a pipeline that only gets TMDs is tuned to TMDs (the Phase-1 failure).

checks.name: vacuum_truncation_plateau
checks.detail: needs E_b at ≥3 increasing vacuum spacings

checks.name: bse_energy_reference
checks.detail: needs GW gap, lowest BSE eigenvalue, and E_b

checks.name: interlayer_exciton_signature
checks.detail: needs intra/inter exciton energies + oscillator strengths
